description: Authorized read_token, no filters, default pagination — expects 200 with patients array
Status filter=active — expects 200, all returned patients have status active
Status filter=deceased — expects 200, all returned patients have status deceased
Authorized write_token, all required fields, status omitted — expects 201 with status defaulting to active
status=inactive on create — expects 201, response.status = inactive
status=deceased on create — expects 201, response.status = deceased
Authorized read_token, valid existing patientId — expects 200 with full patient record
Valid UUID but no matching patient — expects 404
Authorized write_token, valid existing patient, update firstName — expects 200, response echoes sent firstName
Status transition to inactive — expects 200, response.status = inactive
Status transition to deceased — expects 200, response.status = deceased
Deceased-to-active transition (patient pre-set to deceased) — expects 422
Authorized delete_token, valid existing patient — expects 204, subsequent GET returns 404
Valid UUID but no matching patient — expects 404
